---
title: "Analyzing NBA Recruits"
author: "Hugo Lopes"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
basketball_tibble <- read_excel("data/nba_recruits.xlsx") |>
  mutate(
    tier = factor(
      tier,
      levels = c("Never played", "Brief career", "Solid career", "All-Star level", "Superstar"),
      ordered = TRUE
    ),
    recruit_group = factor(
      recruit_group,
      levels = c("#1–10", "#11–25", "#26–50", "#51–100", "Outside top 100"),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )
```

```{r}
basketball_tibble |>
  filter(!is.na(rank), !is.na(top_mean_wa)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = rank, y = top_mean_wa)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = tier)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE, color = "black") +
  geom_text(
    data = \(x) filter(x, top_mean_wa > 15),
    aes(label = name),
    vjust = -0.5,
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "High School Recruit Rank vs. Peak NBA Wins Added",
    subtitle = "Top-ranked recruits tend to achieve higher peak NBA performance, with notable outliers",
    x = "High School Recruit Rank",
    y = "Peak Wins Added (3-Year Mean)",
    color = "Career Tier",
    caption = "Source: The Pudding (2019)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
